privacyContent.s1b: This Privacy Policy explains how Splitter Orbs collects, uses, and protects your personal data. We process data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR/DSGVO).
privacyContent.s2b: The data controller is the app developer. Contact: info@splitterorbs.com.
privacyContent.s3b: Account & Profile Data: display name, game progress, in-game currency, card collection levels, unlocked skins, settings, login streak data. Social Data: friends list, match history. Authentication Data: Google account ID and email if you connect Google. Apple Account ID and email when Apple Sign-In is used.
privacyContent.s4b: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): Processing your game progress is necessary to provide the service. Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): Security measures. Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): Connecting Google is optional.
privacyContent.s5b: Your game data is stored for as long as your account is active. Deleting your account permanently erases all data.
privacyContent.s6b: Supabase hosts our database and authentication. Google is used for optional OAuth. We do not sell your data or use advertising SDKs.
privacyContent.s7b: Under GDPR/DSGVO you have the right to: Access, Rectification, Erasure, Portability, Objection, and Withdraw consent. Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): you may object at any time to processing based on legitimate interest by contacting info@splitterorbs.com. Contact: info@splitterorbs.com.
privacyContent.s8b: Minimum age: 13 in most countries, 14 in Spain/Italy/Austria, 15 in France, 16 in Germany/Netherlands/Ireland.
privacyContent.s9b: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted within the app.
privacyContent.s10b: Felix Werner, c/o COCENTER, Koppoldstr. 1, 86551 Aichach. Email: info@splitterorbs.com
privacyContent.s11b: This app is available only in: Germany, Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, United Kingdom, Portugal, Japan, Switzerland, Austria, Poland, Sweden, Ireland, Denmark, Finland, Norway, and Romania.
privacyContent.s12b: Supabase, Inc. acts as a data processor on our behalf under a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with GDPR Art. 28. Supabase processes your data solely on our instructions. Google LLC acts as a data processor for authentication when you use Google Sign-In. Both processors are contractually bound to protect your data.
privacyContent.s13b: Supabase may store and process your data on servers located outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including in the United States. Such transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission under GDPR Art. 46(2)(c). You may request a copy of the applicable transfer safeguards by contacting info@splitterorbs.com.
privacyContent.s14b: Under GDPR Art. 77, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe your data is being processed unlawfully. The competent supervisory authority for this App is: Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA), Promenade 18, 91522 Ansbach, Germany. Website: www.lda.bayern.de. You may also contact the supervisory authority in your country of residence.
privacyContent.s15b: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects you, as described in GDPR Art. 22. Matchmaking and in-game AI are purely gameplay mechanics with no legal or significant real-world effects.
privacyContent.s16b: The App stores game settings, preferences, and session tokens locally on your device using AsyncStorage (equivalent to local storage). No tracking cookies are used. Supabase automatically logs your IP address and basic device metadata (operating system, app version) for security and abuse prevention purposes under our legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). This data is retained for 90 days.
privacyContent.s17b: In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours as required by GDPR Art. 33. If the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will also notify you directly without undue delay as required by GDPR Art. 34, via the email address associated with your account.
